name: cable front seated row
description: A seated row facing a cable stack. It builds the mid back and lats with smooth constant tension.
instructions: Sit at a cable row station with your feet on the platform and your knees slightly bent.
Grab the handle with both hands and sit tall.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest up and avoid rocking back.
